g.text: deepseek-v4-flash / low | 10 worlds | matched observations, priors and tools
Recovery effect: +70 percentage points; approximate world-bootstrap 95% CI [+55, +85]. Failed sessions: 8/60.
C–D: each pair averages unknown and wrong priors within one world; dark bars show means.
Prediction uses available submissions; failures receive worst regret. Disclosure length is part of the intervention.
